exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal breech delivery, elective cesarean section, emergency cesarean section)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies delivered in breech presentation between 2012 and 2019
finding: Vaginal breech delivery in an experienced setting was associated with a higher incidence of umbilical artery pH < 7.10 compared to cesarean sections, but did not significantly increase the risk of other negative short-term perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: VBD in an experienced setting does not increase the risk of negative short-term perinatal outcomes significantly.
gest_age: Reported, but specific values not included in the abstract
